title.narrative: Food Assistance to Support the School Feeding Program in the Republic of Sierra Leone for the 2024 and 2025 School Year

description.narrative: Provide meals to students in the capital Freetown throughout a full school year; help students in their academic achievement and motivate them to attend classes; ease the burden on families.
Providing snack meals in schools benefiting approximately 68,377 beneficiaries and easing the burden on families in providing food needs for their children.
The project consists of purchasing food supplies and delivering them to the relevant authority to prepare hot meals for students in schools selected in coordination with the Ministry.
